rule: Only this wave's own worktrees and temporary folders are removed, from the main repository, by exact path: git worktree remove <path> for a clean worktree, git worktree remove --force <path> only after both checks pass, Remove-Item -LiteralPath for a folder or file that is not a worktree, never a wildcard. The checks: (a) every tracked change is byte-identical (LF-normalised) to the committed file it produced; (b) every untracked file is byte-identical to its committed copy in the main tree's run folder, or is a reproducible, superseded, non-acceptance output named here. Directories left by earlier waves are not touched.
